g.text: No bare-cell protection onboard. J3 must connect to protected pack output, including protected negative.

g.desc: No bare-cell protection onboard. J3 must connect to protected pack output, including protected negative.

g.text: LDO heat: 0.34W at 200mA; 0.85W at 500mA. Copper cooling and thermal test required.

g.desc: LDO heat: 0.34W at 200mA; 0.85W at 500mA. Copper cooling and thermal test required.

g.text: Do not inject another 3.3V source on main-sheet J1 while battery power is enabled.

g.desc: Do not inject another 3.3V source on main-sheet J1 while battery power is enabled.

g.text: DESIGN REVIEW: protected 4.2V Li-ion/LiPo pack only. SW3 OFF while charging. No power-path.

g.desc: DESIGN REVIEW: protected 4.2V Li-ion/LiPo pack only. SW3 OFF while charging. No power-path.

g.text: BOOST: Vout=0.6*(1+110k/15k)=5.0V nominal. Verify real donor magnetics and load transients.

g.desc: BOOST: Vout=0.6*(1+110k/15k)=5.0V nominal. Verify real donor magnetics and load transients.

g.text: NTC on J5 must contact battery; do not leave it disconnected.

g.desc: NTC on J5 must contact battery; do not leave it disconnected.

g.text: IP2312: USB input 5V only, not QC/PD negotiation. Verify donor IC variant is 4.2V.

g.desc: IP2312: USB input 5V only, not QC/PD negotiation. Verify donor IC variant is 4.2V.

g.text: R8: 1A provisional; battery charge rating must permit it. For 3A use 45k only after review.

g.desc: R8: 1A provisional; battery charge rating must permit it. For 3A use 45k only after review.

g.text: 1S BATTERY POWER - CHARGE OFF / RUN ON

g.desc: 1S BATTERY POWER - CHARGE OFF / RUN ON
